name: ワークスペースの操作メニュー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0016 ワークスペースの操作メニュー.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact five-row workspace popup menu, source region16,72,246,248 normalized. Exact Japanese labels top-to-bottom スペースを切り替え / プランを変更 / 設定 / ごみ箱 / ヘルプ・サポート. Meiryo REGULAR40014px/24px, tracking0, do not bold any item. ORIGINAL source controls all five leading outline glyphs: workspace two horizontal opposing arrows, top arrow LEFT and lower arrow RIGHT; upgrade upward arrow INSIDE a circle, NOT the mock's bare tall chevron; precise small gear with rounded teeth and circular center, NOT rough octagon; trash basket with lid/top handle and three slim internal vertical ribs, NOT plain empty bin; question mark INSIDE a circle, NOT mock's bare question. Keep source glyph proportions, stroke and optical weight, consistent slate#526173 across all icons. Align icon column and label baselines with compact44px rows. Thin neutral inset divider only after first row. Single white rounded popup surface with subtle neutral border and soft downward shadow; pure-white outer canvas. Replace source glass/background blur and mock mint with white official surface; no colored icons or broad tints. No primary action or selected item exists; add no gradient/action button or chevron. Preserve246px logical width and about248px height, uniformly enlarged to readable square around1200x1200 with restrained margins. Do not import source background workspace content, phone chrome, logos or extra menu items.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: No accent justified. Use coherent slate utility glyphs and ink labels on white; source colored background is not popup semantic color.
reviewNotes: 中断callの出力未作成を保存先/manifestで確認して再開。原版優先で5glyphを復元:交換矢印、丸内上矢印、歯車、縦rib付きごみ箱、丸内疑問符。mint/glassは白、全補助iconはslate。生成後に5日本語label、glyph細部、divider、白面、余分な項目なしを目視確認。font同一性/操作/native編集/所有者承認未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
